why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items and neither is broken. On item 1, verifier Check 6 bases its PASS/FAIL on "npm test; echo "exit=$?"". The only mention of `npm run test:cli` is in the Advisory section, which says there is no such script and to "use that" (npm test) instead. So no PASS or FAIL depends on test:cli. On item 2, the builder brief never asks for a general separator option. It says outright: "Do not add handling for unknown arguments, --help, --sep/--delimiter, separator auto-detection, or quoting rules (all out of scope)". The only flag it asks for is --tsv, which is the issue's own scope. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
